events.text: Titles should have repeated spaces collapsed, e.g. 'buy    milk' becomes 'buy milk'. Make that change and update tests.
Collapse whitespace runs in shared validateTitle
Collapse is in `validateTitle` now; next I'm adding tests.
Repeated spaces in titles are collapsed

Titles now have repeated spaces collapsed, so `'buy    milk'` is stored as `'buy milk'`. Tests pass.

**Change** (`main.go:94`): `validateTitle` used to only trim the ends. It now trims and then turns every run of whitespace inside the title into a single space.

**Three things you might not expect:**
- **The bulk importer changes too.** `validateTitle` is shared by `POST /todos` and `/todos/import`, so imported titles get collapsed as well.
- **Tabs and other whitespace collapse, not just spaces.** `"a  b\t\tc"` becomes `"a b c"`.
- **Length limits count the collapsed title.** An 85-character title that is 80 after collapsing used to get a 400 and is now accepted with a 201.

If you want any of these narrower (only `POST /todos`, or only plain spaces), it's a small change.

**Tests added** (`main_test.go`):
- `TestCreateTodoCollapsesRepeatedSpaces`: covers several spaces, leading and trailing spaces, tabs, and an already-clean title.
- `TestCreateTodoLengthCountsCollapsedTitle`: checks the length-limit case above.
- `TestImportCollapsesRepeatedSpaces`: checks that an imported title is stored collapsed.

I recorded the decision in grasp and added a before/after run against the live server for reviewers. Before the change, titles were stored exactly as sent and the 85-character title was rejected; now it's accepted and all titles come back collapsed.

Separately, the linter flags `importer.go:13`: the importer never checks `sc.Err()` after reading, so if reading fails partway (for example, a body over 1 MB), it returns 200 with a partial count. That was already there before my change and I left it alone.

Nothing is committed.

decisions.title: Collapse whitespace runs in shared validateTitle
decisions.why: Collapsing in validateTitle means POST /todos and the bulk importer both store normalized titles. It happens before the length checks, so limits count the collapsed title.
alternatives: Collapse only in validateCreateTitle (POST /todos only), leaving imported titles un-normalized
Collapse only runs of the ASCII space character, leaving tabs and other whitespace as they are
decisions.risk: strings.Fields treats any Unicode whitespace run (tabs, NBSP) as a separator, so a tab inside a title becomes a single space. A title that used to go over the length limit only because of extra spaces is now accepted.
